description: 360 nominal Hijri month/day slots (12 x 30). The 30th of any month is conditional; do not use 365 Gregorian days as Hijri anniversary keys. Individual Hijri years have 354 or 355 days.
data_reuse_status: No permission to bulk extract or redistribute Dorar data; original brief notes and deep links only.
